title: See the Good in Them
author: Sister Kristin M. Yee
author_role: Second Counselor in the Relief Society General Presidency

footnotes.text: David A. Bednar, in “A Conversation on Meekness” (Leadership Enrichment Series, Sept. 15, 2020).

See Russell M. Nelson, “Spiritual Treasures,”Liahona, Nov. 2019, 76–79. “The blessings of priesthood power that members can receive include … revelation to know how to fulfill the work they are ordained, set apart, or assigned to do” (General Handbook: Serving in The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, 3.5, Gospel Library).

“The kingdom of God is not and cannot be complete without women who make sacred covenants and then keep them, women who can speak with the power and authority of God!” (Russell M. Nelson, “A Plea to My Sisters,”Liahona, Nov. 2015, 96). “President Joseph Fielding Smith told sisters of the Relief Society, ‘You can speak with authority, because the Lord has placed authority upon you.’ He also said that the Relief Society has ‘been given power and authority to do a great many things. The work which they do is done by divine authority’ (“Relief Society—an Aid to the Priesthood,”Relief Society Magazine, Jan. 1959, 4, 5)” (Russell M. Nelson, “A Plea to My Sisters,” 98, endnote 7). See also Dallin H. Oaks, “The Keys and Authority of the Priesthood,”Liahona, May 2014, 51.
